---
title: "03_Volcanoplot_lipid_metabolism_NS_GH"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-07"
---
############################################################
# 03_volcano_plot.R
#
# Purpose:
#   Generate a volcano plot from the complete differential-
#   expression results produced by 02_DEG_analysis.R.
#
# Main features:
#   1. User-defined log2FC and FDR thresholds
#   2. Plot ALL genes tested by edgeR
#   3. Highlight significant up/downregulated genes
#   4. Optionally highlight a predefined gene set
#   5. Optionally label highlighted genes only
#   6. Save plot and significant-gene tables
############################################################



# ==========================================================
# 1. USER SETTINGS
# ==========================================================

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Project directory
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# CHANGE THIS to the main directory of your own project.
project_dir <- "YOUR/PROJECT/DIRECTORY/HERE"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# DEG input file
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# IMPORTANT:
# Use the COMPLETE edgeR result table, not the already
# thresholded DEG table.
#
# This corresponds to:
#
#   all_tested_genes_ES_vs_CTL.csv
#
# from the cleaned 02_DEG_analysis.R script.

deg_results_file <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "Results",
  "DGEA",
  "DEG_lists",
  "YOUR_CUTOFF_FOLDER",
  "all_tested_genes_ES_vs_CTL.csv"
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Comparison information
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# The underlying differential-expression contrast should be:
#
#   comparison_group - reference_group
#
# Example:
#
#   ES - CTL
#
# means:
#
#   positive log2FC = higher in ES
#   negative log2FC = higher in CTL

comparison_group <- "ES"
reference_group  <- "CTL"

comparison_name <- paste0(
  comparison_group,
  "_vs_",
  reference_group
)


# Labels shown at the bottom of the volcano plot.
right_text <- paste(
  "Higher in",
  comparison_group
)

left_text <- paste(
  "Higher in",
  reference_group
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# VOLCANO SIGNIFICANCE CUTOFFS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# These thresholds determine which genes are colored as
# significant in the volcano plot.
#
# IMPORTANT:
# They do NOT rerun edgeR.
#
# edgeR already calculated statistics for all genes.
# These thresholds are applied to those complete results.


# ---- OPTION 1: stringent ----
# logFC_cutoff <- 1
# FDR_cutoff   <- 0.05


# ---- OPTION 2: smaller effect-size cutoff ----
logFC_cutoff <- 0.1
FDR_cutoff   <- 0.05


# ---- OPTION 3: exploratory ----
# logFC_cutoff <- 0.1
# FDR_cutoff   <- 0.10


# Only ONE option should be active.


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Gene highlighting
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Do you want to highlight a specific gene set?
highlight_gene_set <- TRUE


# File containing genes to highlight.
#
# The file must contain a column specified below.
#
# Set to NULL when highlight_gene_set = FALSE.

highlight_file <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "YOUR_HIGHLIGHT_GENE_FILE.csv"
)


# Name of the gene column in the highlight file.
highlight_gene_column <- "Gene"


# Highlight color
highlight_color <- "red"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Gene labeling
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Options:
#
#   "highlighted_significant"
#       label only highlighted genes that pass the
#       volcano thresholds
#
#   "all_significant"
#       label all significant genes
#
#   "none"
#       no gene labels

label_mode <- "highlighted_significant"


# Maximum labels for ordinary significant genes.
#
# Highlighted significant genes are always displayed when
# label_mode = "highlighted_significant".
max_overlaps <- 10


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Plot appearance
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Significant genes with negative log2FC
color_left <- "#ADD8E6"

# Significant genes with positive log2FC
color_right <- "#00008B"

# Non-significant genes
color_nonsig <- "grey75"

point_size <- 1.25

highlight_point_size <- 1.8

label_size <- 2.5

plot_width  <- 7
plot_height <- 6


# Extra x-axis space
x_margin <- 0.1


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Output directory
# ----------------------------------------------------------

volcano_dir <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "Results",
  "DGEA",
  "volcano"
)



# ==========================================================
# 2. LOAD PACKAGES
# ==========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)



# ==========================================================
# 3. CHECK USER SETTINGS
# ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists(project_dir)) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Project directory does not exist:\n",
      project_dir
    )
  )
}


if (!file.exists(deg_results_file)) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Complete DEG result file not found:\n",
      deg_results_file,
      "\n\nUse the complete edgeR table produced by ",
      "02_DEG_analysis.R."
    )
  )
}


if (!is.numeric(logFC_cutoff) ||
    length(logFC_cutoff) != 1 ||
    is.na(logFC_cutoff) ||
    logFC_cutoff < 0) {

  stop(
    "logFC_cutoff must be one non-negative numeric value."
  )
}


if (!is.numeric(FDR_cutoff) ||
    length(FDR_cutoff) != 1 ||
    is.na(FDR_cutoff) ||
    FDR_cutoff <= 0 ||
    FDR_cutoff > 1) {

  stop(
    "FDR_cutoff must be >0 and <=1."
  )
}


valid_label_modes <- c(
  "highlighted_significant",
  "all_significant",
  "none"
)


if (!(label_mode %in% valid_label_modes)) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Unknown label_mode.\n",
      "Choose one of:\n",
      paste(
        valid_label_modes,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


dir.create(
  volcano_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)



# ==========================================================
# 4. LOAD COMPLETE DIFFERENTIAL-EXPRESSION RESULTS
# ==========================================================

deg_results <- read.csv(
  deg_results_file,
  check.names = FALSE
)


required_columns <- c(
  "Gene",
  "logFC",
  "FDR"
)


missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(deg_results)
)


if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Required column(s) missing from DEG results:\n",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Basic data checks
# ----------------------------------------------------------

if (!is.numeric(deg_results$logFC)) {

  stop(
    "The logFC column is not numeric."
  )
}


if (!is.numeric(deg_results$FDR)) {

  stop(
    "The FDR column is not numeric."
  )
}


if (any(deg_results$FDR < 0 |
        deg_results$FDR > 1,
        na.rm = TRUE)) {

  stop(
    "FDR values outside the range 0-1 were detected."
  )
}


if (anyDuplicated(deg_results$Gene) > 0) {

  warning(
    paste0(
      "Duplicate gene names were detected in the DEG table.\n",
      "Only the first occurrence will be used for labeling."
    )
  )
}



# ==========================================================
# 5. HANDLE FDR = 0 FOR PLOTTING
# ==========================================================

# -log10(0) is infinite.
#
# If FDR values have been rounded to exactly zero, replace
# them ONLY for plotting with the smallest positive FDR
# observed in the dataset.
#
# Original FDR values remain unchanged.

positive_fdr <- deg_results$FDR[
  deg_results$FDR > 0 &
    !is.na(deg_results$FDR)
]


if (length(positive_fdr) == 0) {

  stop(
    "No positive FDR values are available for plotting."
  )
}


min_positive_fdr <- min(
  positive_fdr
)


deg_results <- deg_results %>%
  mutate(
    FDR_plot = ifelse(
      FDR <= 0,
      min_positive_fdr,
      FDR
    )
  )



# ==========================================================
# 6. CLASSIFY GENES USING THE SELECTED THRESHOLDS
# ==========================================================

deg_results <- deg_results %>%
  mutate(

    Significant =
      FDR < FDR_cutoff &
      abs(logFC) > logFC_cutoff,

    Regulation = case_when(

      FDR < FDR_cutoff &
        logFC > logFC_cutoff
      ~ paste0("Higher_in_", comparison_group),

      FDR < FDR_cutoff &
        logFC < -logFC_cutoff
      ~ paste0("Higher_in_", reference_group),

      TRUE
      ~ "Not_significant"
    )
  )



# ==========================================================
# 7. LOAD OPTIONAL HIGHLIGHT GENE SET
# ==========================================================

highlight_genes <- character(0)


if (highlight_gene_set) {

  if (is.null(highlight_file) ||
      !file.exists(highlight_file)) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Highlighting is enabled but highlight file ",
        "was not found:\n",
        highlight_file
      )
    )
  }


  highlight_data <- read.csv(
    highlight_file,
    check.names = FALSE
  )


  if (!(highlight_gene_column %in%
        colnames(highlight_data))) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Column '",
        highlight_gene_column,
        "' was not found in the highlight file."
      )
    )
  }


  highlight_genes <- unique(
    as.character(
      highlight_data[
        [highlight_gene_column]
      ]
    )
  )


  highlight_genes <- highlight_genes[
    !is.na(highlight_genes) &
      highlight_genes != ""
  ]


  message(
    "Genes in highlight list: ",
    length(highlight_genes)
  )


  message(
    "Highlight genes found in DEG results: ",
    sum(
      highlight_genes %in%
        deg_results$Gene
    )
  )
}



# Mark highlighted genes.
deg_results <- deg_results %>%
  mutate(
    Highlighted =
      Gene %in% highlight_genes
  )



# ==========================================================
# 8. CREATE GENE SUBSETS
# ==========================================================

sig_up <- deg_results %>%
  filter(
    FDR < FDR_cutoff,
    logFC > logFC_cutoff
  )


sig_down <- deg_results %>%
  filter(
    FDR < FDR_cutoff,
    logFC < -logFC_cutoff
  )


highlighted_all <- deg_results %>%
  filter(
    Highlighted
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Gene,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


highlighted_significant <- deg_results %>%
  filter(
    Highlighted,
    Significant
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Gene,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )



# ==========================================================
# 9. REPORT THRESHOLD RESULTS
# ==========================================================

message(
  "Volcano-plot significance criterion:"
)

message(
  "  |log2FC| > ",
  logFC_cutoff
)

message(
  "  FDR < ",
  FDR_cutoff
)


message(
  "Significant genes: ",
  sum(deg_results$Significant)
)


message(
  "Higher in ",
  comparison_group,
  ": ",
  nrow(sig_up)
)


message(
  "Higher in ",
  reference_group,
  ": ",
  nrow(sig_down)
)


if (highlight_gene_set) {

  message(
    "Highlighted genes meeting significance criteria: ",
    nrow(highlighted_significant)
  )
}



# ==========================================================
# 10. DETERMINE PLOT LIMITS
# ==========================================================

# IMPORTANT:
# The same user-selected FDR/logFC thresholds are used here.
#
# The original volcano code sometimes used FDR < 0.1 here
# regardless of the selected plotting threshold. That has
# been removed.

significant_for_limits <- deg_results %>%
  filter(
    Significant
  )


# If no genes meet the threshold, use all genes.
if (nrow(significant_for_limits) == 0) {

  warning(
    paste0(
      "No genes meet the selected thresholds.\n",
      "Plot limits will therefore be calculated using ",
      "all tested genes."
    )
  )

  significant_for_limits <- deg_results
}


x_limit <- max(
  abs(significant_for_limits$logFC),
  na.rm = TRUE
)


y_limit <- max(
  -log10(
    significant_for_limits$FDR_plot
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)


# Safety check
if (!is.finite(x_limit) ||
    x_limit <= 0) {

  x_limit <- max(
    abs(deg_results$logFC),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}


if (!is.finite(y_limit) ||
    y_limit <= 0) {

  y_limit <- max(
    -log10(deg_results$FDR_plot),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}



# ==========================================================
# 11. CREATE BASE VOLCANO PLOT
# ==========================================================

p <- ggplot(
  deg_results,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    y = -log10(FDR_plot)
  )
) +

  # Non-significant genes
  geom_point(
    data = deg_results %>%
      filter(!Significant),
    color = color_nonsig,
    size = point_size
  ) +

  # Significant genes higher in reference group
  geom_point(
    data = sig_down,
    color = color_left,
    size = point_size
  ) +

  # Significant genes higher in comparison group
  geom_point(
    data = sig_up,
    color = color_right,
    size = point_size
  ) +

  # Threshold lines
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(FDR_cutoff),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = logFC_cutoff,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = -logFC_cutoff,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  )



# ==========================================================
# 12. ADD OPTIONAL HIGHLIGHTED GENE SET
# ==========================================================

if (
  highlight_gene_set &&
  nrow(highlighted_all) > 0
) {

  p <- p +

    geom_point(
      data = highlighted_all,
      shape = 21,
      color = highlight_color,
      stroke = 0.8,
      fill = NA,
      size = highlight_point_size
    )
}



# ==========================================================
# 13. ADD GENE LABELS
# ==========================================================

if (
  label_mode ==
  "highlighted_significant"
) {

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Label only highlighted genes that also pass the
  # selected significance thresholds.
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  highlight_left <- highlighted_significant %>%
    filter(
      logFC < -logFC_cutoff
    )


  highlight_right <- highlighted_significant %>%
    filter(
      logFC > logFC_cutoff
    )


  if (nrow(highlight_left) > 0) {

    p <- p +

      geom_text_repel(
        data = highlight_left,
        aes(
          label = Gene
        ),
        color = highlight_color,
        size = label_size,
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        direction = "y",
        nudge_x = -0.4,
        box.padding = 0.7,
        point.padding = 0.6,
        force = 2.5,
        force_pull = 0,
        segment.alpha = 0.3,
        min.segment.length = 0.1,
        seed = 42
      )
  }


  if (nrow(highlight_right) > 0) {

    p <- p +

      geom_text_repel(
        data = highlight_right,
        aes(
          label = Gene
        ),
        color = highlight_color,
        size = label_size,
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        direction = "y",
        nudge_x = 0.4,
        box.padding = 0.7,
        point.padding = 0.6,
        force = 2.5,
        force_pull = 0,
        segment.alpha = 0.3,
        min.segment.length = 0.1,
        seed = 42
      )
  }


} else if (
  label_mode ==
  "all_significant"
) {

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Label all significant genes.
  #
  # max_overlaps controls how many labels ggrepel may omit.
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  if (nrow(sig_down) > 0) {

    p <- p +

      geom_text_repel(
        data = sig_down,
        aes(
          label = Gene
        ),
        size = label_size,
        max.overlaps = max_overlaps,
        segment.alpha = 0.3,
        direction = "both",
        force = 1,
        min.segment.length = 0.25
      )
  }


  if (nrow(sig_up) > 0) {

    p <- p +

      geom_text_repel(
        data = sig_up,
        aes(
          label = Gene
        ),
        size = label_size,
        max.overlaps = max_overlaps,
        segment.alpha = 0.3,
        direction = "both",
        force = 1,
        min.segment.length = 0.25
      )
  }
}



# ==========================================================
# 14. FORMAT PLOT
# ==========================================================

p <- p +

  theme_classic() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "none",

    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    aspect.ratio = 1
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste(
      comparison_group,
      "vs",
      reference_group
    ),

    x = expression(
      Log[2]~"fold change"
    ),

    y = expression(
      -Log[10]~"(FDR)"
    )
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(
      -(x_limit + x_margin),
      x_limit + x_margin
    ),

    ylim = c(
      0,
      y_limit * 1.08
    ),

    clip = "off"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0)
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0)
    )
  )



# ==========================================================
# 15. ADD GROUP-DIRECTION BARS AND LABELS
# ==========================================================

p <- p +

  annotate(
    "segment",

    x =
      -(x_limit + x_margin),

    xend = 0,

    y = 0,
    yend = 0,

    linewidth = 2,

    color = color_left
  ) +

  annotate(
    "segment",

    x = 0,

    xend =
      x_limit + x_margin,

    y = 0,
    yend = 0,

    linewidth = 2,

    color = color_right
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",

    x =
      -(x_limit + x_margin * 0.5),

    y =
      y_limit * 0.03,

    label = left_text,

    hjust = 0,

    fontface = "bold",

    color = color_left,

    size = 4
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",

    x =
      x_limit + x_margin * 0.5,

    y =
      y_limit * 0.03,

    label = right_text,

    hjust = 1,

    fontface = "bold",

    color = color_right,

    size = 4
  )



# ==========================================================
# 16. DISPLAY PLOT
# ==========================================================

print(
  p
)



# ==========================================================
# 17. CREATE DESCRIPTIVE OUTPUT LABEL
# ==========================================================

cutoff_label <- paste0(
  "FDR_",
  format(
    FDR_cutoff,
    trim = TRUE,
    scientific = FALSE
  ),
  "_absLog2FC_",
  format(
    logFC_cutoff,
    trim = TRUE,
    scientific = FALSE
  )
)



# ==========================================================
# 18. SAVE VOLCANO PLOT
# ==========================================================

plot_file <- file.path(
  volcano_dir,
  paste0(
    "volcano_",
    comparison_name,
    "_",
    cutoff_label,
    ".pdf"
  )
)


ggsave(
  filename = plot_file,
  plot = p,
  device = "pdf",
  width = plot_width,
  height = plot_height,
  units = "in"
)


message(
  "Volcano plot saved to:\n",
  plot_file
)



# ==========================================================
# 19. SAVE GENES MEETING VOLCANO THRESHOLDS
# ==========================================================

significant_output <- deg_results %>%
  filter(
    Significant
  )


write.csv(
  significant_output,
  file.path(
    volcano_dir,
    paste0(
      "volcano_significant_genes_",
      comparison_name,
      "_",
      cutoff_label,
      ".csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)



# ==========================================================
# 20. SAVE HIGHLIGHTED GENES
# ==========================================================

if (
  highlight_gene_set
) {

  write.csv(
    highlighted_all,
    file.path(
      volcano_dir,
      paste0(
        "highlighted_genes_present_",
        comparison_name,
        ".csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  write.csv(
    highlighted_significant,
    file.path(
      volcano_dir,
      paste0(
        "highlighted_significant_genes_",
        comparison_name,
        "_",
        cutoff_label,
        ".csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}



# ==========================================================
# 21. SAVE VOLCANO SUMMARY
# ==========================================================

volcano_summary <- data.frame(

  Comparison =
    paste(
      comparison_group,
      "vs",
      reference_group
    ),

  Tested_genes =
    nrow(deg_results),

  log2FC_cutoff =
    logFC_cutoff,

  FDR_cutoff =
    FDR_cutoff,

  Significant_genes =
    sum(
      deg_results$Significant
    ),

  Higher_in_comparison_group =
    nrow(sig_up),

  Higher_in_reference_group =
    nrow(sig_down),

  Highlight_genes_in_dataset =
    nrow(highlighted_all),

  Highlight_genes_significant =
    nrow(highlighted_significant)
)


print(
  volcano_summary
)


write.csv(
  volcano_summary,
  file.path(
    volcano_dir,
    paste0(
      "volcano_summary_",
      comparison_name,
      "_",
      cutoff_label,
      ".csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)



# ==========================================================
# 22. SAVE SESSION INFORMATION
# ==========================================================

capture.output(
  sessionInfo(),
  file = file.path(
    volcano_dir,
    paste0(
      "sessionInfo_03_volcano_",
      comparison_name,
      ".txt"
    )
  )
)
